title: Companion farewell lines never vary regardless of how much story has moved on: Lys said the exact line 'Mind your footing. This wood doesn't forgive twice.' verbatim every single time I ended a conversation with her across many separate visits in the Vale and Thornwold; Tamsin's 'Watch your footing. I'm not carrying you back.' repeated identically just as often. It reads as a canned tag rather than a reactive companion.
where: Multiple rooms / ending any conversation with Lys or Tamsin
